name: Mixed-media linking and provider preview
statement: Users can accomplish mixed-media linking and provider preview while preserving user-owned meaning, usability and consent.
requiredProperties: Image and gallery items independently attach other images, links, files, notes and media
Media can be a remote URL, local authorized resource, R2 object or bundled export with truthful availability
Resource re-use does not duplicate underlying file bytes
Right-hand inspector previews notes, images, video and supported files while graph stays visible
Resizable split inspector compares local preview above R2 preview below
Respect provider authentication, grant boundaries, content sanitization and offline states
